clean_story:
Early failure detection. Machine health forecasting.

Predictive Maintenance means fixing machines before they break by spotting early signs of trouble. A factory motor’s vibration may seem steady, but sensors catch a subtle wobble—a bearing wearing thin. Like a doctor hearing a faint heart murmur before a crisis hits. Algorithms compare real-time data to past breakdowns, predicting when a part will fail within days or hours. Airlines use it to replace jet engine blades before cracks spread. Downtime drops by up to 50 percent, costs shrink. No guesswork. Just data turning whispers into warnings.

Three related subjects are condition monitoring, failure mode analysis and industrial automation.
